text:
Ana: Heads-up: we need a surgical cut to keep the MVP ship date. Quick proposals below.
Devon: go for it.
Ana: Proposal: MVP includes runtime perf fixes, core REST/API, minimal model pin by id (API + CLI), a tiny console header showing pinned model, and basic canary toggle. Defer: full pin-management UI, advanced tag filters, route-level long-retention telemetry, embeddings dashboard, and the automated eval/regression alerting to v1.
Kai: Agree. Full pin UI is a 3-sprint frontend lift. Backend proto is ready.
Raj: Pilots want fast rollback. Can we provide a rollback endpoint + CLI so they can revert without UI?
Devon: Yes  POST /v1/pins/rollback + small CLI wrapper. That cuts ~2 FE sprint-weeks.
Marie: UX: include the tiny header with current pinned model + link to CLI docs so pilots aren't confused. I'll draft copy.
Ana: Canary: keep minimal toggle + % slider; advanced rollout flows to v1.
Devon: Estimates: CLI + header + toggle = 10 dev-days; rollback endpoint = 4 dev-days; canary safety tests = 6 dev-days. Total ~20 dev-days if FE cuts hold.
Kai: I'll validate rollback <3min and canary fallback latency add <500ms. Will run the safety runbook tomorrow.
Raj: I'll notify pilots (@acme_pilot @greenleaf_pilot) and surface objections.
release-bot: Milestone freeze in 8 business days. last build cutoff: 3632112000.
Ana: Action items: Devon confirm final estimates EOD; Kai run SLA validation; Marie draft header & CLI docs; Raj get pilot sign-off. I'll update milestone tracker and move UI pieces to v1 backlog.
Devon: Also add rollback audit trail logging (request_id + actor)  low lift, high value.
Marie: UX note: header copy must say "pinned models are global to tenant".
Ana: OK team, lock scope by EOD tomorrow unless pilots push back. Closing for now.
